tasks.name: 删除指定向量
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== 删除从指定楼层起的 L0 + L1（可独立设置） ======
// 创建手动触发循环任务，将此代码完整放入命令框。
// 修改下方 L0_FROM_FLOOR / L1_FROM_FLOOR 变量，点击任务按钮即可生效（0-base，含此楼）。
// 设 -1 表示跳过对应层的删除。

(async () => {
    // ====== 修改这里 =====
    const L0_FROM_FLOOR = -1;  // L0（atoms / index / state vectors）从这一楼起删除（含此楼，0-base）；-1 跳过
    const L1_FROM_FLOOR = -1;  // L1（chunks / chunk vectors）从这一楼起删除（含此楼，0-base）；-1 跳过
    // =====================

    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const { chatId } = getContext();
    if (!chatId) {
        window.toastr?.error('❌ 未打开聊天');
        return;
    }

    const chunkStore = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/storage/chunk-store.js');
    const stateStore = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/storage/state-store.js');

    const metaBefore = await chunkStore.getMeta(chatId);
    const lastChunkFloor = metaBefore?.lastChunkFloor ?? -1;
    const statsBefore = await chunkStore.getStorageStats(chatId);

    const skipL0 = L0_FROM_FLOOR < 0;
    const skipL1 = L1_FROM_FLOOR < 0;

    // L1: 删 chunks + chunk vectors
    if (!skipL1) {
        await chunkStore.deleteChunksFromFloor(chatId, L1_FROM_FLOOR);
    }

    // L0: 删 atoms + L0 index + state vectors
    if (!skipL0) {
        stateStore.deleteStateAtomsFromFloor(L0_FROM_FLOOR);
        stateStore.deleteL0IndexFromFloor(L0_FROM_FLOOR);
        await stateStore.deleteStateVectorsFromFloor(chatId, L0_FROM_FLOOR);
    }

    // 更新 meta.lastChunkFloor：L1_FROM_FLOOR ≤ lastChunkFloor 时把进度截断到 L1_FROM_FLOOR-1
    if (!skipL1 && L1_FROM_FLOOR <= lastChunkFloor) {
        await chunkStore.updateMeta(chatId, { lastChunkFloor: L1_FROM_FLOOR - 1 });
    }

    const statsAfter = await chunkStore.getStorageStats(chatId);

    const l0Label = skipL0 ? '跳过' : `${L0_FROM_FLOOR}`;
    const l1Label = skipL1 ? '跳过' : `${L1_FROM_FLOOR}`;
    const lastChunkFloorAfter = skipL1 ? lastChunkFloor : Math.min(L1_FROM_FLOOR - 1, lastChunkFloor);

    window.toastr?.success(
        `✅ L0/L1 删除完成\n` +
        `L0 (atoms/index/state vectors) from floor: ${l0Label}\n` +
        `L1 (chunks/chunk vectors)    from floor: ${l1Label}\n` +
        `L1 chunks: ${statsBefore.chunks} → ${statsAfter.chunks}\n` +
        `Chunk vectors: ${statsBefore.chunkVectors} → ${statsAfter.chunkVectors}\n` +
        `lastChunkFloor: ${lastChunkFloor} → ${lastChunkFloorAfter}`,
        'L0/L1 删除',
        { timeOut: 6000 }
    );

    console.info(
        `[task] L0/L1 删除: L0 from ${l0Label}, L1 from ${l1Label}. ` +
        `chunks ${statsBefore.chunks}→${statsAfter.chunks}, ` +
        `chunkVectors ${statsBefore.chunkVectors}→${statsAfter.chunkVectors}`
    );
})();
<</taskjs>>
